name: Arcanist Doan
summary: Arcanist Doan is a master human mage residing within the Athenaeum of the Scarlet Monastery's Library wing. He serves the Scarlet Crusade as one of its most lethal arcane specialists and guardian of key crusade archives.

sections.title: Keeper of the Athenaeum
sections.body: While the fanatical ranks of the Scarlet Crusade lean heavily on martial fury and holy fervor, Doan remained convinced that raw arcane power was essential to purging the Scourge from Lordaeron. Stationed deep inside the Athenaeum of the Monastery's library, he was entrusted as both a lorekeeper and an operational gatekeeper, safeguarding the Scarlet Key that secures crusade sanctuaries across the northern kingdoms.

faq.q: Why is a mage in the Scarlet Crusade?
faq.answer: Although the Crusade is dominated by zealot paladins and priests, Doan firmly believes that masterwork arcane magic is an indispensable weapon needed to cleanse the Scourge from Lordaeron.

faq.q: What is Arcanist Doan's connection to the Ashbringer?
faq.answer: None is known. Doan is known as the keeper of the Scarlet Monastery's library and the guardian of the Scarlet Key, not as part of the Ashbringer's story.

faq.q: What does Doan guard in the Library?
faq.answer: Doan keeps watch over the Monastery's repository of books and historical records in the Athenaeum. Behind him sits a lockbox containing the Scarlet Key, an essential key that opens the locked gates to the Monastery's Armory and Cathedral wings.

faq.q: What magic does Doan use in combat?
faq.answer: Doan is famous for casting an Arcane Bubble that renders him invulnerable while he channels a massive, room-engulfing Detonation spell. He also disrupts spellcasters with area silences and polymorphs threats into sheep.

faq.q: Where did Doan fight during the Third War?
faq.answer: His deeds in the Third War are not recorded. Today he is known as the keeper of the Scarlet Monastery's library, where he guards the Athenaeum and the Scarlet Key.

faq.q: Does Doan harbor any personal secrets?
faq.answer: Doan serves as an arcanist of the Scarlet Crusade. His private romantic attachments are unrecorded in the Classic sources.

angles.text: Doan's mastery of arcane defenses makes his protective bubble a vivid example of magical warding.
Paladins will find in Doan a rare arcanist trusted by the Scarlet Crusade, an order that otherwise prizes the Light above all other powers.
For Alliance forces, Doan shows how far the Scarlet Crusade's zeal reaches, binding even a master of the arcane to its violent paranoia.
The Forsaken and their Horde allies see Doan as a dangerous Scarlet commander whose library shelters vital intelligence and keys needed to breach the Crusade's inner sanctums.
